items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: He had Ed Jones playing Trampon on there.

ctx.x: Yeah. And where was his place?

His place was say a ball, a ballroom you know. And he didn't have much of a dancing space there. About in the Corner of Basin. About in Corner of Basin.
